paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, anung sawt lou in, buhlak hun in, Samson in kelnou tawi in azi ava veh hi. "Dantan sung ah ka zi kiang ah ka va lut ding," achi hi. Himahleh apa'n alut aphalta kei hi.
Apa'n, “Amah na ho mahmah ka sa a, huaiziak in na lawmpa kiang ah ka peta hi. Anau amah sang in amelhoih zaw hilou hia?" achi hi.
Samson in, "Tutung in Philistiate khoih leng amau sang in dem ka kai kei zaw ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Samson in sihal zathum ava man a, meisel ala a, amei uleh mei apehkhawm a, amei uh kikal chiat ah meisel akoih chiat hi.
Meiselte adettak in Philistiate buhlak ah atailutsak a, buhphal leh buh dingh laite, olive munte toh nangawn in akang vek hi.

Huchi in Philistiate'n, "Kua hih ahia?" achi uh. Amau, "Timnah a mi makpapa Samson hih ahi. Huai Timnah a mi in Samson zi alawmpa zi dia apiak man ahi," akichi uhi. Huchi in Philistiate ahong kuan ua apata un ahallumta uhi.
Samson in akiang uah, "Hichibang na hih uh leh na tung uah phu ka la sam ding, huai khit in ka tawp ding," achi hi.
Huchi in nakpitak in asual a, tampi athat a, apaisuk a, Etam suangpi tung ah a-omta hi.
Huchi in Philistiate ahohtou ua, Judah gam ah ava kikulh ua, Lehi mun ah akiphalh uhi.
heading: Samson In Philistiate Azou

paite: Judah gam a mite'n, "Bangchidan ahia kou sual dia na hong kuan mawk uh?" achi uhi. Amau, "Samson khaukhih a ka tung ua ahih mah bang a ama tung a leng hih ding in ka hong uh," achi uhi.

Huchi in Judah gam a mi sangthum Etam suangpi tung ah ahoh ua, Samson kiang ah, "Philistiate i tung ua vaihawmte ahih uh thei lou na maw? Bangchidan a hichibang a ka tung ua thil hon hihta mai na hia oi?" achi uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka tung a, ahih bang ua ke'n leng amau tung a hih sam ka hi,” achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Nang hon khaukhih a, Philistiate khut a hon pe dia hong kuan ka hi uh," achi uhi. Samson in akiang uah, "Noute'n hon that lou ding in ka kiang ah kichiam un," achi hi.

Amau akiang ah, "That lou e. Himahleh ka hon khaukhih tinten ding ua, akhut ua hon pe ding ka hi uh. Thah zaw ka hon that kei hial ding uh," achi uhi. Huchi in khauzen thak nih in akhih ua, suangpi a pan apita uhi.

Lehi mun ahong tun in, Philistiate'n ana dawn ua, ana kikou zuazua uhi. TOUPA kha atung ah nakpitak in ahong tung a, huchi in aban a gakna khauzen ziza zang mei in kangtat bang mai ahong hita a, agaknate a khut a pan akekhe niang maimah uhi.
Sabiltung khaguh thak amu a, asawk a, ala a, huai in mi sangkhat asatlum hi.
Samson in, "Sabiltung khaguh in ka chiang vum venvon a, sabiltung khaguh in mi sangkhat ka satlum,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, athugen khit in akhaguh tawi apai a; huai mun Ramath Lehi asa hi.
Adang atak mahmah a, TOUPA asam a, "Nang na sikha khut zang in thupitak in na hon hunkheta hi. Tu in dangtak in ka si mai ding maw? Zeksumlouhte khut ah ka puklut dia hia?" achi hi.

Himahleh Pathian in Lehi mun a leikuak akhisak a, tui ahong kikhohkheta hi. Huai adawntak in alungsim ahong halh a, ahong hat nawnta hi. Huai mun min En-hakkore asa a; tuni tan in Lehi mun ah a-om lai hi.
Huchi in Philistiate hun in Israelte tung ah kum sawmnih vai ahawm hi.
